q: My opponent has 5 cards in their hand and 5 cards in their trash.
Can I activate this card's 1st effect and play it with the play cost reduced by 5?

a: The play cost is reduced by 5.
Even if they have 10 cards in their hand and 10 cards in their trash, the reduction to the play cost will be 5.
q: My opponent has 10 cards in their hand and 10 cards in their trash.
If I activate this card's 1st effect, what is the reduction to the play cost?

Effect: When this card would be played, if your opponent has 10 or more cards in either their hand or trash, reduce the play cost by 5.

[On Play] [When Digivolving] Your opponent trashes cards in their hand so that they have 6 cards left. If this effect didn't trash, you may play 1 level 5 or lower [Fallen Angel] trait Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.
[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] If your opponent has 6 or more cards in their hand, they trash 1 of them. Then, if they have 5 or fewer, delete 1 of their lowest level Digimon.
